+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M3ETV0A0AE2F2MTGWTFHF7T4
+- 01M3ETTBXPEYFR2DSBAZHMQVXB
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8480'
+title: 'Change the live suites for the same-model refusal: assert the refusal and split the single-model profiles'
+---
+## What
+Before, a nested `respond` on the same model from inside a tool call deadlocked silently. `NestedGenerationProbeTests.swift:1-30` documents the old `generationGate` hang. With the new Router it is refused at once with `GenerationQueueError.waitInsideOpenSubmission(model:)`. Change the live suites under `IntegrationTests/Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolIntegrationTests/` to match:
+
+1. `NestedGenerationProbeTests.swift` and `Fixtures/IntegrationNestedGenerationTool.swift` (`:111`, a nested `slot.makeSession().respond` on the outer `.standard` slot): the probe now asserts that the in-band nested call gets `waitInsideOpenSubmission` quickly, inside a short time limit, and does not hang. Rewrite the doc comment, which explains the old `AsyncSemaphore` deadlock, to describe the refusal. If a case asserts that a background body can do the nested call, keep it.
+2. `Support/LiveRouterFixture.swift`: `plumbingProbeProfile` (`:405-410`) and `agentDiscoveryProfile` (`:439-444`) put one model in both `standard` and `flash`. For each suite that uses these profiles and runs `searchTools` from inside a session (for example `AgentSurfaceDiscoveryTests.swift:162`), give `standard` a different model, or show that the suite calls the selection tier outside a submission (for example `SelectionForkPerCallTests.swift:134` constructs `SearchToolsTool` directly). Write the reason in the profile doc comment.
+3. `RespondDrainTests.swift`: read what it asserts about the old drain of queued prompts. Keep the intent through the new message queue (`send(_:) -> MessageID`, `pendingMessages()`), or delete the test with a comment in the commit message if the Router now owns that behavior.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] No live profile that runs `searchTools` inside a session has the same model in `standard` and `flash`. A model-free unit test enforces this for each shared profile constant that can be reached from the unit test target (`CLIRunner.demoProfile`).
+- [ ] The nested-generation probe fails if the nested call hangs longer than its time limit, and passes when it gets `waitInsideOpenSubmission`.
+- [ ] `swift test --package-path IntegrationTests --no-parallel` passes on a machine that has the models.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `IntegrationTests/.../NestedGenerationProbeTests.swift`: rewritten to assert the refusal.
+- [ ] Run `swift build --package-path IntegrationTests --build-tests`. Expected result: it passes.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --package-path IntegrationTests --no-parallel --filter 'NestedGenerationProbeTests|AgentSurfaceDiscoveryTests|SelectionForkPerCallTests|RespondDrainTests'`. Expected result: it passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd`. Write failing tests first, then do the implementation that makes them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
